evals.prompt: Add a welcome email when users sign up in my Next.js app.
evals.expected_output: Recommends Notify transactional send via server-side notifycx or fetch; mentions domain verification for production from address.
expectations: Uses server-side send (Route Handler or backend)
Mentions verified domain for custom from
Does not put API key in client code

evals.prompt: I want to send a monthly newsletter to 10,000 subscribers with Notify.
evals.expected_output: Declines or redirects — Notify is not for newsletters/marketing.
expectations: States Notify is for transactional email not newsletters
Does not provide a bulk newsletter implementation as a Notify feature

evals.prompt: Configure my app to send password reset emails through Notify with a Reply-To header.
evals.expected_output: Explains Notify send API has no reply-to field; suggest handling replies differently or omitting reply-to.
expectations: Does not invent a reply-to API field
Uses documented body fields to, from, subject, html/text/message

evals.prompt: I'm on the free plan and haven't verified a domain yet. How can I test the send API?
evals.expected_output: Points to POST /api/email/send/test or sendTest / send_test_email MCP; explains non-delivering rehearsal.
expectations: Does not claim test endpoint delivers mail
Mentions domain verification for production send

evals.prompt: Wire Supabase Auth magic link emails through Notify instead of SMTP.
evals.expected_output: Points to Supabase Send Email Hook recipe and server-side NOTIFY_API_KEY.
expectations: References Supabase hook or supabase-auth docs on notify.cx
Uses HTTP API or SDK not SMTP
